scope: Phase 1 — Pilot (6 weeks, cap $25,000): joint discovery & integration-design workshop; current-state mapping of Zendesk, shipment API, and support workflow; success metrics and pilot acceptance criteria; Zendesk inbound/outbound integration with ticket threading, email drafting, and agent-side visibility; secure read-only connector to shipment API with response-schema normalization, short-TTL cache, fault-tolerant retries, and PII-safe logging; LLM intent classifier plus grounded “where is my shipment” first-response generator with retrieval over live tracking data, hallucination guardrails, and refusal rules; confidence-gated auto-reply vs. human escalation with structured summary attachment and queue prioritization; pilot analytics dashboard tracking deflection rate, AHT delta, escalation accuracy, CSAT proxy, and cost-per-resolution; UAT support, pilot go-live, and 2 weeks of live-traffic stabilization and threshold tuning.

Phase 2 — Full build (separate SOW, begins only after pilot review): delivery-address-change automation with intent + slot-filling against the OMS endpoint, write-back confirmation flow, and multi-step confirmation handling for ambiguous cases; invoice-copy automation against the billing API or PDF store with follow-up handling for unresolved lookups; damage-claim intake with structured form capture from email, photo attachment handling, validation against policy rules, and ticket handoff to the claims team; unified escalation routing, structured logging, observability, cost and latency guardrails, on-call alerting, and weekly performance review; runbooks, agent training, and enablement materials for your 40-person support org; a 4-week optimization sprint against labeled production traffic.

draft.summary: We will deploy an LLM-driven triage and first-response layer in front of your Zendesk inbox that resolves your four high-volume question types — shipment status, delivery-address change, invoice reissue, and damage claims — by querying your live shipment API and grounding its replies in current tracking data, while routing everything else to your human agents with a structured summary attached. The engagement is split: a focused 6-week pilot on the “where is my shipment” case so you can measure deflection and AHT impact on production traffic before committing, followed by a separately scoped full rollout of the remaining three cases plus hardening, monitoring, and team handoff.

sharedState.request:
We're a 40-person logistics company and our customer support inbox is drowning. About 300 emails a day, and roughly half are the same four questions: where is my shipment, can I change the delivery address, how do I get an invoice copy, and how do I file a damage claim.

We want an automated first-response layer that answers those four cases directly from our shipment database, and routes everything else to a human with a summary attached. Must integrate with our existing Zendesk and our internal shipment API. We'd like a pilot on the "where is my shipment" case first so we can measure it before committing to the rest.

Timeline: pilot live within six weeks. Budget is not fixed but we'll need the pilot under $25k to get it approved. Please break out the pilot separately from the full build.
